correctness.rationale: Itô conversion of the constant body-frame SPD Stratonovich mobility gives an exact decomposition into a rotating Brownian endpoint and conditionally independent translational noise. Regenerative cycle moments yield the entire covariance for all positive parameters. The two needed rational identities, cubic factorization, strict positive-root uniqueness and orientation of the excess eigenvectors were checked symbolically and analytically. A reproducible exact-cycle Monte Carlo test independently corroborates all six tested sign comparisons. Fixed-time numerical checks are not substituted for the infinite-time renewal theorem.

value.rationale: The experimentally relevant question is which transverse or longitudinal fluctuations limit colloidal separation when the reset clock itself is stochastic. Unlike a routine replacement of a deterministic period by its mean, the random clock introduces an extra longitudinal centered-reward term and produces a strict, universal, rate-dependent inversion absent for every deterministic period. The threshold governs the full observable covariance when the Schur complement is isotropic, while exact subtraction identifies it for arbitrary SPD coupling.
